about: Which systems of record the connector emulators can stand in for, and which record kinds each emulated connector holds. `worldloom.industry` reads this to turn a compiled catalogue's `sor_product` into connector source roles: a product listed here becomes a source on the named connector, with its catalogue objects mapped to the connector's entities; a product absent from `products` is reported by the programme as unemulated and its bindings draw evidence only from the channels the catalogue says the work lands in. A channel mapped to null has no emulator (a chat message, a workflow approval, a portal filing) and is reported the same way. The mapping is versioned in the file name: a change to which connector stands in for a system changes every programme derived from it, so it is a new version, never an edit.
